remarks: HIGHEST AND BEST DUE by Sunday 7/20 at 5pm. Welcome to this beautiful move-in ready 3-bedroom, 2-full bath home offering one-story living on a flat .70 acres. Designed for both comfort and style this home offers everything you've been looking for. Step inside to find open-concept living. The heart of the home is the kitchen complete with natural stone Quartzite countertops, SS appliances, and soft-close cabinetry. Great Room includes custom mudroom area with built-in cubbies, plus sliding doors that open to Bluestone patio and fully fenced-in private backyard-perfect for relaxing or hosting guests. Formal living room with vaulted ceilings, large bay window and fireplace with wood-burning insert adds warmth & character, while also helping reduce the heating bill. At the end of a long day retreat to the primary suite with marble en-suite bathroom, dedicated vanity area, heated towel bar, and radiant floors. Custom walk-in closet and secondary closet provide ample storage. Two additional bedrooms and updated full bath with tub. Dedicated laundry closet. Hardwood floors and recessed lighting throughout. Solar-vented skylights with remote blinds. Fully finished basement offering versatile flex space. Attached 2-car garage with just one step into the home. Attached carport and open-air shed. The highly sought-after William Street Neighborhood is just minutes from Calf Pasture Beach, East Norwalk Metro, Downtown Westport & Stew Leonard's. There's nothing to do but move in.
